description: This Java interface defines hashing utilities, including Murmur-3 hash functions and SHA-256 digest methods, for use within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides methods to generate hash seeds, compute hashes for strings, and produce pseudorandom integers from string seeds.

classes.name: Hashes
classes.description: Interface providing hashing functions including Murmur-3 and SHA-256 based utilities.

methods.name: getSeeds
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve hash seeds.

methods.name: getHashes
methods.description: Default method to compute multiple hash codes for a string using the seed list.

methods.name: murmurHash
methods.description: Static method to compute Murmur-3 hash for a string with a given seed.

methods.name: digestStringsToIntegers
methods.description: Static method to generate pseudorandom integers from a string seed using SHA-256 digest.

methods.name: getSha256
methods.description: Static method to obtain a SHA-256 MessageDigest instance.
